result.topic_en: Calculations of the moduli (periodicity factors) of theta-type functions x and y with respect to period systems b and c, followed by expansion of a quadratic form in summation variables m in terms of the moduli r and b.

methods.what: Definition of modulus (period factor) of theta-variable x with respect to period b, symmetry relation of r
Linear change of variables from x to y
Modulus of x^{0,β}_p with respect to b^{0,β±β'}_p in terms of r
Expansion of the quadratic form in theta series exponent in terms of moduli r and b
methods.quote: $2\sum m^{\alpha,\beta}_{\nu} x^{\alpha,\beta}_{\nu} + 2\sum m^{0,\gamma}_{p-1} x^{0,\gamma}_{p-1} + 2\sum m^{0,\beta}_{p} x^{0,\beta}_{p} + 2m^0 x^0$

methods.what: Substitution of summation variables m to diagonalize
Character sums of moduli defining s
